integrity: Analytical proof accompanies a 63-case exact-rational checker; finite tests do not certify universal statements; no independent review has been conducted.
scientific_limitations: The claim concerns exact one-time stationary Gaussian marginals of stable Euler--Maruyama schemes for fully observed symmetric positive drift and shared unknown isotropic noise; finite-sample, nonisotropic and general nonlinear inference are not covered. Classical AR(1) ingredients are acknowledged; independent historical priority review has not been performed.
title: One-grid stationary aliases and exact two-grid recovery in Gaussian Euler--Maruyama dynamics
